content.title: About
content.content: Orange juice 100 % is a natural juice made from ripe oranges, enriched with calcium. It is available in cans, bottles, and carton packs. The drink provides vitamin C, flavonoids and other micronutrients, while the added calcium supports bone health.

content.title: Interesting Facts
items: Calcium is added in a micro‑crystalline form that is easily absorbed by the body.
The juice can be stored for up to 12 months in a sealed container at room temperature.
Orange juice is widely used in cooking: for marinades, sauces and cocktails.
Unlike many fruit juices, this product contains no added sugar.
Carton packaging is made from recyclable materials and protects the juice from light.

items.title: Rich in vitamin C
items.content: Vitamin C boosts immunity, supports collagen synthesis and acts as an antioxidant.

items.title: Supports bone health
items.content: Added calcium helps maintain bone density and reduces the risk of osteoporosis.

items.title: Contains flavonoids
items.content: Flavonoids have anti‑inflammatory and cardiovascular protective effects.

items.title: Hydration
items.content: The juice is almost entirely water, contributing to proper fluid balance.

items.title: Low in calories
items.content: One cup (250 ml) provides about 110 kcal, making it suitable for diet plans.

items.title: Citrus allergy
items.content: Some individuals may experience allergic reactions to oranges.

items.title: Acidity
items.content: High acidity can irritate the stomach lining in people with gastritis or ulcers.

items.title: Sugar content
items.content: Although no sugar is added, natural sugars may affect blood glucose levels.

items.title: Medication interactions
items.content: Calcium can reduce the absorption of certain antibiotics and iron, so take them at different times.

content.title: How to Eat
content.content: Drink the juice chilled, use it in smoothies, cocktails, sauces and marinades. For optimal calcium absorption, pair it with vitamin D‑rich foods.

content.title: Storage
content.content: Store in a cool, dry place away from direct sunlight. After opening, keep refrigerated and consume within 5 days.
